text:
linh: Heads-up — planning to onboard fjord-3b (lite variant) into model-catalog tomorrow 08:30 PT. Low-perf/light footprint; target traffic 0->100% over 30m. Looking for a deploy owner and two people for smoke/rollback checks.
marie: I can own deploy. Will be on at 08:15 PT.
tony: I can do infra watch (autoscaler & routing). ETA 08:10 PT.
sree: I’ll be on-call for any perf regressions, can run quick kv/prefix cache sanity.
linh: thanks. quick checklist: 1) pin alias -> fjord-3b 2) canary 5% for 10m 3) monitor token latency, error-rate, mem spikes 4) rollback plan + who triggers.
zach: product FYI — no downstream schema changes; just inference variant. I'll watch for consumer regressions.
marie: Rollback plan: revert alias to previous (fjord-3b:v0.9.3) + scale down new variant. If >2% 5xx or +40% 95th latency for 5m, rollback.
marie: Quick config I'm planning to push:
```yaml
pin:
  alias: fjord-3b
  model: fjord-3b-lite
  version: v1.0.0
  canary: 5%
  rollout: 
    - step: canary
      duration_m: 10
      target_percent: 5
    - step: ramp
      duration_m: 20
      target_percent: 100
```
tony: add infra knobs: batch_size=auto, max_tokens=2048, quant_profile=8bit to keep mem in check. Also will pin kernel selection to cuFFT-optimized path.
sree: Smoke list (I'll run): 1) simple prompt latency 2) long prompt streaming 3) KV cache hit after prefix reuse 4) token-delta cost sanity 5) memory & GPU utilization.
linh: ops-bot — create deploy ticket and schedule quiet-window? @ops-bot
ops-bot: deploy ticket created: https://tickets.redwood/DFJ-834 — quiet-window scheduled 08:30-09:30 PT — please add post-deploy smoke notes to ticket. :white_check_mark:
marie: tagging owners on ticket and adding smoke template. Running preflight now against staging.
linh: if staging smoke passes, we'll proceed with 08:30 canary. If any blocker, abort roll and bump to next day.
zach: small ask — notify customers in catalog changelog (short blurb). I'll draft.
marie: preflight pass in staging at 07:50 PT — no regressions. Ready for 08:30.
linh: thanks — see you on thread for live updates. Please ping here the moment you flip the alias and on each step (5%, ramp).
marie: flipping alias now (canary 5%).
marie: canary 5% live — monitoring.
tony: infra looks steady. CPU/GPU / mem normal.
sree: smoke run #1 OK (latency within expected). Continuing streaming test.
marie: canary 5% -> 25% (ramp) at +12m.
ops-bot: alert: error-rate spike (1.8%) at +14m — source: one consumer region.
sree: investigating region routing, rolling back region-specific route to fallback model for that region.
marie: decision: hold ramp, keep canary at 25% while we validate. If error persists 5m, full rollback.
zach: informing product stakeholders in thread.
marie: error source identified — mis-homed routing rule for eu-west; patching now.
tonY: (typo) tony: patch applied, rebalancing traffic.
sree: re-run smoke in eu-west — looks clean.
marie: resuming ramp to 100% over next 18m.
marie: rollout complete 100% at +40m. No sustained errors. Closing ticket with smoke notes.
linh: awesome — thanks all. Postmortem notes: add perf numbers and KV hit rate to catalog entry.
zach: added changelog entry + link to ticket. :rocket:
